title: The anti-inflammatory activity of palmitoleic acid from macadamia nuts.
authors: Sun, Wen-Hui; Li, Ya-Zhuan; Dai, Wen; Tan, Chin-Ping; Rong, Xiao-Song; Xu, Yong-Jiang
one_liner_zh: 研究澳洲坚果棕榈油酸的抗炎活性及NRF2/TBK1信号通路，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Macadamia nuts are rich in a variety of nutrients and are prone to oxidative deterioration during storage and transportation. They contain a high level of monounsaturated fatty acids, whose composition may change during oxidation. In this study, we determined the oxidation indicators of macadamia nuts and the changes in the proportion of monounsaturated fatty acids. In addition, we demonstrated that POA intervention reduced excessive mitochondrial superoxide production, thereby alleviating oxidative stress and mitigating inflammation. The alleviation of inflammation was associated with reduced lysosomal damage, as evidenced by increased expression of LAMP2 and ATP6V1A, decreased CTSB levels, and enhanced lysosomal biogenesis. In vitro assays further revealed that POA treatment increased NRF2 expression while decreasing TBK1 expression. Molecular docking analysis suggested that the interaction between POA and NRF2 may involve key residues including valine (VAL-418, VAL-512 and VAL-465). Overall, POA alleviated cell inflammation through the NRF2/TBK1 signaling pathway. This study provides insights into the anti-inflammatory mechanisms of POA, highlighting its potential as a therapeutic agent.
abstract_zh: 澳洲坚果富含多种营养物质，但在储存和运输过程中易发生氧化变质。其含有高水平的单不饱和脂肪酸，氧化过程中其组成可能发生变化。本研究测定了澳洲坚果的氧化指标及单不饱和脂肪酸比例的变化。此外，我们证明POA干预减少了过量的线粒体超氧化物产生，从而缓解了氧化应激并减轻了炎症。炎症的缓解与溶酶体损伤的减少相关，表现为LAMP2和ATP6V1A表达增加、CTSB水平降低以及溶酶体生物发生增强。体外实验进一步揭示，POA处理增加了NRF2表达，同时降低了TBK1表达。分子对接分析表明，POA与NRF2之间的相互作用可能涉及关键残基，包括缬氨酸（VAL-418、VAL-512和VAL-465）。总体而言，POA通过NRF2/TBK1信号通路减轻了细胞炎症。本研究为POA的抗炎机制提供了见解，凸显了其作为治疗剂的潜力。
